windows.text: Commercial crude oil inventories increased by 2.0 million barrels - U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA)

Over the past four weeks, total product demand averaged 20.4 million b/d, down 1% year over year. Gasoline demand increased 1% to 8.9 million b/d, while distillate demand increased 2% to 3.7 million b/d. Jet fuel demand increased 9% year over year. The increase demand for transportation fuels was offset by decreasing demand in residual fuel oil, propane, and other oils.
